name: Acting Like Lovers
source:
Two stars, one scripted romance—yet the chemistry feels too real. In a world of fame, secrets, and staged love, will your heart follow the script or rewrite the story?

[From [url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/acting-like-lovers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两位明星，一段按剧本出演的合约恋情——可彼此擦出的火花却真实得令人心惊。在这个充斥着名利、秘密与逢场作戏的世界里，你的心究竟会照本宣科，还是亲手改写这段故事？

[摘自[url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/acting-like-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
